description: Curated creative 404 references — study technique breakdowns, not surface clones

references.name: iyO
references.concept: 404 emerges from concentric circle segments — mathematical moiré, not a typed numeral
references.typography: Small brand wordmark below graphic; poetic microcopy in light sans — type supports geometry, not hero
references.layoutPattern: Centered stage BUT the hero IS generative geometry — not icon + headline template
assetRequirements: Build 404 from circle segments with varying stroke/opacity — NOT border-radius div rings
Generative or SVG path segments that form digits when combined
stealList: Poetic product copy tied to brand metaphor
avoidList: Plain CSS border circles pretending to be iyO
references.motion: GSAP: stagger segment opacity; pulse rings; optional cursor-linked distortion
references.interaction: Cursor-influenced ring distortion or segment reveal
references.notOneShot: Segment geometry → moiré lockup → GSAP timeline → cursor interaction

references.name: Maxima
references.concept: Playful search narrative — illustrated character with binoculars, oversized 404 type
references.typography: Bold rounded display numerals + friendly sans; illustration carries personality
references.layoutPattern: Character + type composition with intentional overlap and sky/ground layers
assetRequirements: Original illustration or cohesive scene — not stock clipart
references.motion: GSAP: float clouds, character idle, staggered 404 entrance
references.interaction: Custom cursor; hover on character or CTA
references.notOneShot: Illustration pass → layout → character animation → cursor polish

references.name: Maxime Ducret — TILT 404
references.concept: 404 as playable tilt puzzle — error becomes engagement
references.typography: Architectural grotesk; NOT FOUND + 404 hierarchy; move counter as UI chrome
references.layoutPattern: Game board centered; chrome in corners; monochrome discipline
references.motion: GSAP: physics-like tile movement; restart transitions
references.interaction: Keyboard/button controls; move counter; win state
references.notOneShot: Game logic first → minimal UI → motion polish → tutorial copy

references.name: Follow.Art
references.concept: PAGE NOT FOUND as monumental type filling viewport + hand-drawn X texture overlay
references.typography: Ultra-condensed stretched display — type IS the image; nav tiny by contrast
references.layoutPattern: Full-bleed color field; type at extreme scale; CTA corner-placed not centered
assetRequirements: Display type large enough to dominate frame (not normal h1 size)
Textured X mark — SVG stroke draw or raster texture
CTA in corner with sharp edges
references.motion: GSAP: X draw-on or texture reveal; type scale entrance
references.interaction: CTA hover; optional cursor follow on X
references.notOneShot: Type lockup → texture asset → entrance timeline

references.name: The Missing Element
references.concept: Off the map — cinematic jellyfish in deep sea; poetic bilingual copy
references.typography: Stencil/block display OFF THE MAP; monospaced metadata in corners; Italian body
references.layoutPattern: Asymmetric editorial — corners hold metadata; hero type overlaps photo subject
assetRequirements: Cinematic hero asset (photo-grade or detailed SVG)
Asymmetric type placement — not centered stack
avoidList: Dot grid overlay on dark bg
references.motion: GSAP: particle drift, jellyfish float, subtle parallax
references.interaction: Hover on CTA frame; ambient motion loop
references.notOneShot: Asset grade → layout → ambient loop → CTA states

references.name: Corentin Bernadou
references.concept: Bold typographic 404 — type scale as the entire experience
references.motion: GSAP: type reveal, weight or tracking shift
references.notOneShot: Type scale lockup → GSAP reveal → hover polish
